title: Employments
parallelConfirmationDescription: This employee already has an active employment. Are you sure you want to create a second, parallel employment?
firstContractStartDateHelp: The first payroll contract always starts on the employment start date.
contractStartDateMinimumHelp: A payroll contract cannot start before the employment start date.
duplicateWarning: This employee may already exist. Review the candidates before continuing.
dashboardNoActive: No active employment; the last employment has ended or has not started yet.
noActiveContract: No active contract for this employment
contractSelectionHelp: First select the payroll contract this change applies to.
selectedContractStatement: This is the contract we are changing.
dateOutsideContract: The effective date must fall within the selected contract.
changeStartDateTitle: When does the change take effect?
changeStartDateHelp: Choose the date when the new hours, salary or organization data takes effect.
changeNotAvailable: This change is not available in this screen yet.
noLinks: No external links have been added yet.
changeDiscardDescription: Unsaved changes in this employment mutation will be lost.
changeFailed: The change could not be saved.
twkWarning: The effective date is in the past. This may affect pay, leave, pension, filings and corrections. Review the consequences before confirming.
normalConfirmText: Check the effective date and data. A new time block will be added after confirmation.
rollbackWarning: Only the furthest future time block is deleted. This lets you correct step by step; earlier blocks remain intact.
onlyBlockProtected: The only remaining time block cannot be deleted.
factorCalculated: Calculated automatically from contract hours and capped at 100%.
allocationMustBe100: The cost allocation must total exactly 100%.
impactScheduleSalary: A change in hours may change actual salary.
impactSchedulePayroll: Review the impact on the next payroll run.
impactSalaryOrganization: Check whether role and grading still align.
impactSalaryLabor: Review collective agreement, scale and employment conditions.
impactSalaryPayroll: Review payroll, taxes and any retroactive corrections.
impactLaborSchedule: Check whether the schedule fits the scheme.
auditEmpty: No actions for this employment yet.
chainClear: No chain rule risk found based on the known history.
chainAttention: This is probably the final temporary contract in the current chain. Review the collective agreement and exceptions.
chainIndefinite: An indefinite contract is likely to arise. You may continue, but record your reasoning.
chainInsufficient: Contract history is incomplete; check earlier employer or agency periods.
salaryRestricted: You are not allowed to view salary data.
companyLocationDescription: Record where this employee works for each employment. A new effective date automatically becomes the successor to the previous location.
noLocations: No active locations have been configured yet.
singleLocationMode: This company has no separate locations configured. The employee therefore works at the company address.
timeMapSubtitle: All recorded changes in context, with an as-of date for time travel.
workPatternNoPatterns: No work pattern has been recorded yet.
workPatternFailed: Could not save the work pattern. Check that its average matches the hours agreement.
workPatternLoadFailed: Work patterns could not be loaded.
workPatternCorrelationHelp: The hours agreement and work pattern have separate timelines; their weekly averages must match.
prerequisitesTitle: Before we can create the employment, please complete the following information.
prerequisiteSaved: The employee details have been saved.
employeeConflict: The employee details have changed in the meantime. Check the details and try again.
employmentNumberConflict: The employment or income-relationship number is already in use. Check the numbers and try again.
bsnOptionalHelp: Not required to create an employment. Leave it empty if the citizen service number is not known yet.
bsnHashKeyMissing: The citizen service number cannot be saved locally because the server setting BSN_HASH_KEY is missing. Have this setting added and try again.
ageRangeInvalid: The employee must be between 10 and 90 years old.
payrollChoiceHelp: You can enter the payroll contract details as the next step. You can also do this later.
contractShortWarning: The contract is shorter than one month. Check the end date; you can still save this choice.
startDatePastWarning: The start date is more than one month in the past.
startDateFutureWarning: The start date is more than two months in the future.
probationLongWarning: The probation period is longer than three months. Check the end date; you can still save this choice.
probationOutsideContract: The probation end date is after the end of the fixed-term contract.
probationNotAllowed: A probation period is not allowed for a contract of six months or less.
probationMaximumExceeded: The selected probation period exceeds the legal maximum for this contract duration.
probationCaoMaximum: The selected CBA allows a maximum probation period of two months for this contract duration.
probationMaximum: Maximum probation period according to CBA
hoursAgreementHelp: Set the agreed hours first, then distribute them across the weekly schedule.
rosterHelp: Distribute the hours across the days. The average must match the hours agreement.
rosterHoursFormat: Enter schedule hours as hours and minutes, for example 7,30 for 7 hours and 30 minutes.
rosterMismatch: The schedule must exactly match the hours per week.
weeklyHoursInvalid: The workweek cannot be negative and may contain at most 50 hours.
frequencySingleHelp: This administration allows only one payment frequency; it is used automatically.
frequencyNone: No payment frequency is configured for this administration.
managerDerived: Determined automatically from the department and HR setup.
noConfiguredManager: No manager is configured for this department.
splitCostCenter: You can split costs across multiple cost centers. The cost carrier applies to the whole allocation. The total must be 100%.
optionsLoading: Loading the data for the selected administration…
createHint: Review the details. After confirmation, the employment, contract and all timelines are created in one transaction.
contractAddBlocked: End the current contract before adding a consecutive contract.
employmentSettingsSubtitle: General setup and master data for new employments and contracts.
defaultEmploymentCountry: Default country for a new employment
regulationTimelineDescription: Manage arrangements over time. Each successor connects directly to the previous version.
regulationContinuityHint: The previous version automatically remains valid until the day before this start date. A successor must start after the previous version.
salaryBandPercentageHelp: Change the percentage or the full-time salary; both values stay linked.

salaryStructures.description: Link one or more logical salary structures to this CBA version. The link controls availability; a revision remains separately dated.
salaryStructures.failed: The links could not be saved.
salaryStructures.readOnly: Read-only: you cannot change the CBA links.

salaryApplication.externalAmount: The amount is determined later by the salary/payroll engine.
salaryApplication.intro: Choose which salary routes this administration may use. The choice filters new salary selections only; existing history remains unchanged.
salaryApplication.routeDescription: Manual remains available. Scales and salary bands are offered only when an active HR-group structure is linked.
salaryApplication.minimumWageDescription: Choose REGULAR or BBL; payroll determines the current amount later.
salaryApplication.scaleWithStepsDescription: Choose a published scale and step. The amount follows the revision effective on the start date.
salaryApplication.salaryBandDescription: Choose a band and enter the full-time salary. Position and band status are calculated automatically.
salaryApplication.structuresDescription: Link only structures that may be chosen in this administration. Linking does not change existing salary rules.
salaryApplication.failed: The salary settings could not be saved.
salaryApplication.readOnly: Read-only: you cannot change the salary settings.
